can_locate_by_decision_id.verdict: partial — ReceiptEnvelope stores governance_decision_id in decision field, but manifest.jsonl does not include decision_id. Finding a specific decision requires a linear scan of all sharded JSON files. No index on decision_id.
can_locate_by_decision_id.can_fix: add governance_decision_id to manifest.jsonl; add in-memory or file-based index on decision_id → envelope_id mapping

can_replay_from_receipt_store.verdict: yes — each ReceiptEnvelope is a standalone sharded JSON file. The envelope can be deserialized without runtime state. Manifest provides ordered list. But replay requires reading each file (one per decision). A DuckDB projection over manifest + envelope files would enable efficient replay.
can_replay_from_receipt_store.can_fix: DuckDB projection: read manifest.jsonl (4 cols) + recursively read envelope JSON files into governance_decisions table

can_correlate_across_dimensions.verdict: partial — decision.governance_decision_id correlates to GateDecision.decision_id. decision.surface, decision.authority_tier, decision.capability_id enable surface-filtered queries. But manifest only indexes session_id (from subject.session_id). No query by surface, authority_tier, capability_id, request_id without scanning all files.
can_correlate_across_dimensions.can_fix: add surface, authority_tier, capability_id to manifest; add manifest index on governance_decision_id

are_sharded_files_sufficient_for_replay.verdict: yes for small-to-medium volumes. FilesystemReceiptStore is append-only, sharded, with manifest.jsonl ordered index. For large volumes (10k+ envelopes), manifest linear scan becomes bottleneck. Corruption risk: individual shard corruption is contained; manifest corruption loses ordering.
are_sharded_files_sufficient_for_replay.can_fix: add receipt_count to manifest for cross-validation; add DuckDB projection for efficient queries beyond 1k envelopes

minimum_projection_for_cockpit_and_procu.verdict: defined in companion artifact governance_evidence_replay_projection_design_v1.v1.json. Minimum: DuckDB read-side table governance_decisions with columns from ReceiptEnvelope decision + manifest fields. Enables: 'why blocked?', session history, surface activity, decision timeline.
minimum_projection_for_cockpit_and_procu.can_fix: P1: DuckDB governance_decisions projection; P3: Postgres governance_decisions materialized view

missing_fields_from_evidence_artifacts.verdict: 7 gaps identified. 1. ReceiptSubject missing session_id for governance decisions from GovernanceRuntime (agent_loop surface). 2. ReceiptDecision missing request_id for cross-surface correlation. 3. Manifest missing 5 fields (decision_id, surface, authority_tier, capability_id, request_id). 4. ReceiptEnvelope missing trace_id for distributed tracing. 5. No redaction_scan_id on ReceiptEnvelope. 6. No producer field (module/version). 7. No sequence field for hash-chain ordering.
missing_fields_from_evidence_artifacts.can_fix: P0: add decision_id, surface, authority_tier, capability_id to manifest; P1: add request_id, trace_id, producer, redaction_scan_id, sequence to envelope/decision/subject models

required_tests_before_replayable.verdict: defined in companion artifact governance_evidence_replay_test_strategy_v1.v1.json. 20 proposed tests covering: decision_id lookup, manifest scan, session correlation, surface filtering, DuckDB projection equivalence, corrupted shard handling, forbidden raw content absence, content-light field completeness.
required_tests_before_replayable.can_fix: P1: implement replay tests; P2: add adversarial/sabotage tests for corrupted manifest and shard tampering

receipt_store_read_side_assessment.append_behavior: append-only; sharded by first 2 hex of envelope_id; each write is atomic (single file write + manifest append)
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.manifest_fields: envelope_id, receipt_kind, session_id, created_at — only 4 fields indexed
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.list_read_complexity: O(N) linear scan of manifest.jsonl; each envelope retrieval is O(1) file read by sharded path
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.o_n_risks: list_by_session scans entire manifest; 10k+ entries means 10k line reads. No pagination index within manifest.
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.atomicity: file write is atomic; manifest append is line-by-line (not atomic with file write). Crash between file write and manifest append loses manifest entry but envelope file exists (orphaned).
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.corruption_behavior: orphaned envelope files (no manifest entry) are invisible to list(); corrupted manifest line is silently skipped; corrupted envelope file returns None from get(). No quarantine directory.
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.content_light_behavior: all stored data is content-light by construction (ReceiptEnvelope validates). Manifest stores only identifiers, no raw content.
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.local_mode_suitability: excellent for local-first evidence. Sharded files are portable, inspectable, copyable. JSONL manifest is human-readable.
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.postgres_projection_suitability: good — manifest.jsonl can be bulk-imported to Postgres. Envelope files can be parsed on-demand or pre-indexed. Dual-write architecture compatible.
receipt_store_read_side_assessment.duckdb_parquet_projection_help: would eliminate O(N) scan bottlenecks. DuckDB can read manifest.jsonl directly and join with parsed envelope JSON files via glob. Parquet would compress and speed queries.
